programme.title: De Board of Soekie / De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: Because he tells juicy gossip, Rudyard finally gets attention from the girl he has had a crush for years. She wants more gossip from him. Rudyard does not want to lose her attention and starts to come up with spectacular gossip. He did not think that his gossip would take on big proportions, so that even his best friend Soekie should resign as chairman. / Omdat hij sappige roddels vertelt, krijgt Rudyard eindelijk aandacht van het meisje waar hij al jarenlang een crush op heeft. Ze wil meer roddels van hem. Rudyard wil haar aandacht niet verliezen en begint spectaculaire roddels te verzinnen. Hij had niet gedacht dat zijn roddels zon grote proporties zouden aannemen waardoor zelfs zijn beste vriendin Soekie moet aftreden als voorzitter.

programme.title: The Hoppers / De Hoppers
programme.desc: Geert is in shock when he discovers that his youth hero and fishstick icon, captain Frigo, has been replaced by a new, younger captain. Together with Daria and Jackie, he organizes a Belmarathon to collect signatures that must ensure that the old captain can come back. In the meantime, Arno and Mo see their chance to make money. They think that Mo should become the new captain Frigo and thus enter the competition with Geert, Daria and Jackie. / Geert is in shock wanneer hij ontdekt dat zijn jeugdheld en fishstickicoon, Kapitein Frigo, vervangen is door een nieuwe, jongere kapitein. Hij organiseert samen met Daria en Jackie een belmarathon om handtekeningen te verzamelen die ervoor moeten zorgen dat de oude kapitein Frigo kan terugkomen. Ondertussen zien Arno en Mo hun kans om geld te verdienen. Ze vinden dat Mo de nieuwe Kapitein Frigo moet worden en gaan zo de competitie aan met Geert, Daria en Jackie.

programme.title: The rules of Floor / De regels van Floor
programme.desc: A 90s party is being organized at the school of Floor. When Jan hears that his big idol is coming to run DJ Mike, he is crazy. He enthusiastically collects his old records and turntable in the hope of being able to turn at the party. To the great shame of Floor. / Op de school van Floor wordt een jaren 90 feest georganiseerd. Wanneer Jan hoort dat zijn grote idool DJ Mike komt draaien, is hij door het dolle heen. Enthousiast verzamelt hij zijn oude platen en draaitafel in de hoop ook op het feest te mogen draaien. Tot grote schaamte van Floor.

programme.title: The rules of Floor / De regels van Floor
programme.desc: Floor has to go to Ellie, an artist and old girlfriend of her mother. Ellie once made a jacket for Floor: the most horrible jacket of all time. And even more horrible: Floor has to put it on! / Floor moet mee naar Ellie, een kunstenares en oude vriendin van haar moeder. Ellie heeft ooit een jas voor Floor gemaakt: de meest afgrijselijke jas aller tijden. En nog afgrijselijker: Floor moet hem aandoen!

programme.title: In other words / Met andere woorden
programme.desc: Whether the Hopper family could win a golden K? Sarah and Thomas know everything about that! / Of de familie Hopper een Gouden K zou kunnen winnen? Daar weten Sarah en Thomas alles van!

programme.title: De Board of Soekie / De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: Pedro wants to turn the brol into an elite school. That's good for his image. To achieve that, he decides that only the 1% smartest children are still taught. The 99% other students no longer receive lessons. They can play colors and play games in the basement. As a result, they become stupid and the 1% smart children become smarter. Soekie is revolting because everyone is entitled to education. But she finds no support among the fellow students. They are happy that they should not take lessons. / Pedro wil van het BROL een eliteschool maken. Dat is goed voor zijn imago. Om dat te bereiken, beslist hij dat enkel de 1% slimste kinderen nog les krijgen. De 99% andere leerlingen krijgen geen les meer. Ze mogen in de kelder kleuren en spelletjes spelen. Ze worden daardoor dommer en de 1% slimme kinderen worden slimmer. Soekie komt in opstand omdat iedereen recht heeft op onderwijs. Maar ze vindt geen steun bij de medeleerlingen. Die zijn blij dat ze geen les moeten volgen.

programme.title: Bernie / Bernie
programme.desc: Funny animation series about the brilliant inventor Bernie who is lost on the bottom of the ocean. With his clumsy and crazy new neighbors, a return to the island is not easy! / Grappige animatiereeks over de geniale uitvinder Bernie die verdwaald is op de bodem van de oceaan. Met zijn onhandige en maffe nieuwe buren wordt een terugkeer naar het eiland alvast niet makkelijk!

programme.title: The Hoppers / De Hoppers
programme.desc: Daria and Arno realize that they are both so different. Daria believes that Arno has an easy life. All he does is chill. Arno believes that Daria is always far too serious. Arno is convinced that Daria can't even chill. Daria takes on the challenge: she will be Arno, but then Arno must be Daria. The two soon discover that it is not nearly that easy to be each other. / Daria en Arno beseffen dat ze allebei zo anders zijn. Daria vindt dat Arno een gemakkelijk leven heeft. Het enige wat hij doet is chillen. Arno vindt dat Daria altijd veel te serieus is. Arno is ervan overtuigd dat Daria niet eens kan chillen. Daria gaat de uitdaging aan: zij zal Arno zijn, maar dan moet Arno Daria zijn. De twee ontdekken al gauw dat het lang niet zo gemakkelijk is om elkaar te zijn.

programme.title: The Athena / The Athena
programme.desc: Nyela Malik has a big wish: designing her own clothing line. And to realize that wish, no better place is conceivable than The Athena, a prominent art academy in London. / Nyela Malik heeft een grote wens: het ontwerpen van een eigen kledinglijn. En om die wens te realiseren is er geen betere plek denkbaar dan The Athena, een vooraanstaande kunstacademie in Londen.

programme.title: 3Hz / 3Hz
programme.desc: After the death of his mom, Felix discovers that his Walkman can do something special. Together with Sammy and Noor, he catches a disturbing conversation about a murder in 1989. / Na de dood van zijn mama ontdekt Felix dat zijn walkman iets bijzonders kan. Samen met Sammy en Noor vangt hij een verontrustend gesprek op over een moord in 1989.

programme.title: Campus 12: Compilation / Campus 12: compilatie
programme.desc: Tough boxer Noah de Smidt sees his twin sister Bo mysteriously disappear. He seems to be the only one who still remembers Bo, but that is not included in Sam; A young DJ who is also in Boksclub Campus B, but is not exactly Noah's best friend. Together the two go looking for the exhausted girl. Their search leads to the theater of the rival Vincke family and the boys can only infiltrate the choir. And that is just the tip of the iceberg ... / Stoere bokser Noah De Smidt ziet zijn tweelingzus Bo op mysterieuze wijze verdwijnen. Hij lijkt de enige te zijn die zich Bo nog herinnert, maar dat is buiten Sam gerekend; een jonge dj die ook in boksclub Campus B vertoeft, maar niet bepaald Noahs beste vriend is. Samen gaan de twee op zoek naar het uitgewiste meisje. Hun zoektocht leidt naar het theater van de rivaliserende familie Vincke en de jongens kunnen niet anders dan het koor te infiltreren. En dat is slechts het topje van de ijsberg...

programme.desc: The new format, the author's travel-recorted journalist Biljana Stokic, discovery what the heart of the people tells about the Serbian, the tradition and history of our cities and villages, their everyday life and the struggle for preserving true values, diligent work, faith, and love for theirs and ours, Otamb. programme.title: Fundus / Fundus
programme.desc: "Fundus" is a TV story format whose themes are BH. Cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of valuable cultural treasure that preserve museums across the country. The best promotion of the state is through its rich and varied culture. Museum depots keep thousands of valuable cases and exhibits, including numerous world rarities. Collections and collections do not even lag behind the settings in reputable European and world museums. This form of BHRT wants to present them to the general public and remind them of their value. The stories are processed only by basic and most interesting details, with the aim of encouraging viewers to visit museums and institutions in which exhibits are found. In the fundus you will see the interesting facts you haven't known so far, the items you haven't seen before, and it will also present part of the tradition on which there is no information recorded. / "Fundus" je format TV priča čije su teme bh. kulturno-historijsko naslijeđe, nepoznate priče i detalji iz naše baštine, ali i podsjećanje na vrijedno kulturno blago koje čuvaju muzeji širom zemlje. Najbolja promocija države je preko njene bogate i raznovrsne kulture. Muzejski depoi čuvaju hiljade vrijednih predmeta i eksponata, među kojima su brojni svjetski rariteti. Kolekcije i zbirke ni po čemu ne zaostaju za postavkama u uglednim evropskim i svjetskim muzejima. Ovom formom BHRT želi da ih predstavi široj javnosti i podsjeti na njihovu vrijednost. Priče obrađuju samo osnovne i najzanimljivije detalje, s ciljem da potaknu gledatelje da za više informacija posjete muzeje i ustanove u kojima se nalaze eksponati. U Fundusu ćete vidjeti zanimljivosti koje do sada niste znali, predmete koje niste prije vidjeli, a predstaviće i dio tradicije o kojoj nema zabilježenih informacija.

programme.title: Black gold / Crno zlato
programme.desc: On the Arab peninsula, during the 1930s, two Emir were clashed. The winner of Nesib, Emir Hobeike, appointed peacetime conditions to his rival Amar, Sultan Salmah. They agreed that none has the right of ownership of the country called a yellow belt. As a pledge to respect the agreement, Nesib adopts two Amar's sons, Saleh and Auda. Twelve years later, fighting Saleh wants to escape the gold cage and return to the Father. Auda is hollowed in books and longing for acquiring knowledge. One day, a American woman from Texas comes visiting Nesib. He informs him that his country is full of oil and promises his fortune that he can't even imagine. Nesib imagines unprecedented possibilities ... The kingdom with roads, schools and hospitals, funded with black gold lying under dry sand. Still, there's a problem. Precious sites are in the yellow belt. The struggle for the rule over the yellow belt is followed, also a struggle for two kingdoms and control over the future. Roles: Tahar Rahim, Antonio Bandreas, Mark Strong, Freida Pinto Director: Jean-Jacques Annaud / Na arapskom poluostrvu, tokom 1930-ih godina, sukobila su se dvojica emira. Pobjednik Nesib, emir Hobeike, postavio je mirnodopske uslove svom suparniku Amaru, sultanu Salmaha. Složili su se da nijedan nema pravo vlasništva nad zemljom zvanom Žuti pojas. Kao zalog da će poštovati dogovor, Nesib usvaja dvojicu Amarovih sinova, Saleha i Audu. Dvanaest godina poslije, borbeni Saleh želi pobjeći iz zlatnog kaveza i vratiti se ocu. Auda je udubljen u knjige i žudi za sticanjem znanja. Jednog dana, u posjetu Nesibu dolazi Amerikanac iz Teksasa. Obavještava ga da je njegova zemlja puna nafte i obećava mu bogatstvo kakvo ne može ni zamisliti. Nesib zamišlja neviđene mogućnosti... kraljevstvo sa cestama, školama i bolnicama, finansirane crnim zlatom koje leži ispod suhog pijeska. Ipak, postoji problem. Dragocjena nalazišta su u Žutom pojasu. Slijedi borba za vladavinu nad Žutim pojasom, ujedno i borba za dva kraljevstva i kontrolom nad budućnosti. Uloge: Tahar Rahim, Antonio Bandreas, Mark Strong, Freida Pinto Režija: Jean-Jacques Annaud

programme.desc: The mysteries of Dr. Blake (The Doctor: The Doctor Blake Mysteries) is an Australian television series first aired on ABC on February 1, 2013 at 8:30 pm [1]. Creg Dugal McLlan is in the role of Dr. Lucien Blake, who returned to Balarat, northwest of Melbourne, in the late 1950s, to take over the general medical practice of his late father and the role of a police surgeon after 30 years. Five seasons have been broadcast until 2017, after which the program is closed at the end of the fifth season. The first two seasons have 10 episodes while the next ones have 8 each. Each episode is about an hour - between 56 and 59 minutes. / Мистериите на доктор Блейк (на английски: The Doctor Blake Mysteries) е австралийски телевизионен сериал, излъчен за първи път по ABC на 1 февруари 2013 г. в 20:30 часа[1]. Крег Дугъл Маклалън е в ролята на доктор Лусиен Блейк, който се завръща в Баларат, северозападно от Мелбърн, в края на 1950-те години, за да поеме общата медицинска практика на покойния си баща и ролята на полицейски хирург след отсъствие от 30 години. Пет сезона се излъчват до 2017 г., след което програмата е закрита в края на петия сезон. Първите два сезона имат 10 епизода докато следващите имат по 8. Всеки епизод е около час – между 56 и 59 минути.

Sisa's sister Sophie Charlotte wants to win the heart of King Ludvig in every way. Bratu Louisu ponuđeno je mjesto ministra pravosuđa, ali da bi ga dobio, mora otkazati planirano vjenčanje s opernom pjevačicom Henriette. Sisina sestra Sophie Charlotte na svaki način želi osvojiti srce kralja Ludviga. programme.title: Cultural heritage / Kulturna baština
programme.desc: Cultural Heritage - (Doc. Series, Croatia, 2013) We were last in Ludbreg at a time when Batthyany Castle, the most important monument in the city, was just one of many neglected and - which in this case was particularly important - empty historical assemblies. Specifically, artwork was evacuated here from war -ended or occupied parts of Croatia. Today, we were greeted by a small town aware of its history, which, like the thermal complex, the rest of the ancient iovia, is systematically explored. Likewise, the renovated Batthyany castle received a new purpose and tenants. It houses the Ludbreg Restoration Center, part of the Croatian Restoration Institute from Zagreb, where sculptures, paintings, textiles will be renewed to continue to decorate churches, museums and other public or private spaces. R.: Luka Marotti ... / Kulturna baština - (dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2013) U Ludbregu smo posljednji put bili u doba kad je dvorac Batthyany, najvažniji spomenik u gradu, bio samo jedan od mnogih zapuštenih i - što je u ovom slučaju bilo osobito važno - praznih povijesnih sklopova. Naime, ovamo su se evakuirale umjetnine iz ratom ugroženih ili okupiranih dijelova Hrvatske. Danas, dočekao nas je gradić itekako svjestan svoje povijesti koja se, poput termalnog kompleksa, ostatka antičke Iovije, sustavno istražuje. Isto tako, obnovljeni dvorac Batthyany dobio je novu namjenu i stanare. U njemu je smješten Restauratorski centar Ludbreg, dio Restauratorskog zavoda Hrvatske iz Zagreba, gdje će se skulpture, slike, tekstil obnoviti da bi i dalje ukrašavali crkve, muzeje i druge javne ili privatne prostore. R.: Luka Marotti...

programme.title: Gardener / Vrtlarica
programme.desc: Gardener - (S04, E08, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2023) For all those who feel nature as part of their lives, for those who enjoy the beauty of green plants and flowers, for those who have introduced gardening into their everyday life, there is a garden. Starting from the position of nature protection and its own health, the author of Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, in addition to the already well -known stories of organic growing vegetables, fruits and flowers, also explores new areas related to the horticulture and the green plant world. It reveals breeders that are plants and passion and life, beautifully shaped gardens, but also ways in which plants we can prepare, process and use in everyday life. The base and origin of these studies is the author's garden located on the Zagorje side of the hillside of Medvednica. He is a place of permanent experts with plants, but also a meeting place with interesting guests who transmit their own experiences about breeding or using plants. However, the author goes on, traveling around Croatia and meets interesting places and people who have tied their lives to the cultivation of some unusual species. For all those who want to really relax and enjoy the content that will provide inspiration and many useful ideas, Sunday afternoon will be reserved for the gardener from now on. R.: Nino Šoštarić ... / Vrtlarica - (S04, E08, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2023) Za sve one koji prirodu osjećaju kao dio svog života, za one koji uživaju u ljepoti zelenih biljaka i cvijeća, za one koji su vrtlarstvo uveli u svoju svakodnevicu, tu je emisija Vrtlarica. Polazeći s pozicije zaštite prirode i vlastitog zdravlja, autorica Kornelija Benyovsky Šoštarić, uz već poznate priče o organskom uzgoju povrća, voća i cvijeća, istražuje i nova područja vezana uz hortikulturu i zeleni biljni svijet. Otkriva uzgajivače kojima su biljke i strast i život, predivno oblikovane vrtove, ali i načine na koje biljke možemo pripremiti, preraditi i koristiti u svakodnevnom životu. Baza i ishodište tih istraživanja je autoričin vrt smješten na zagorskoj strani obronaka Medvednice. On je mjesto stalnih eksperimanata s biljakama, ali i mjesto susreta sa zanimljivim gostima koji prenose vlastita iskustva o uzgoju ili korištenju biljaka. No, autorica polazi i dalje, putuje po Hrvatskoj i upoznaje zanimljiva mjesta i ljude koji su svoj život vezali uz uzgoj neke neobične vrste. Za sve one koji se žele doista opustiti i uživati u sadržaju koji će pružiti inspiraciju i mnoštvo korisnih ideja, nedjelja poslijepodne bit će od sada rezervirana za Vrtlaricu. R.: Nino Šoštarić...

programme.title: David Skoko: Eat on the road / David Skoko: Jesti na cesti
programme.desc: David Skoko: Eat on the road - (E03, Education Program, Croatia, 2025) The Gastronomic tour of David jump moves south, on Korčula. He visits Mark Turkovic, top chef, which worked in numerous restaurants with two and three Michelin stars, and today he runs his restaurant in which he cooks exclusively on live heat. Marko and David will talk about traditional foods, but prepare them according to the principles of street food. In this episode, they are looking for recipes for Korcula Street food. R.: Radislav Jovanov Gonzo ... / David Skoko: Jesti na cesti - (E03, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) Gastronomska turneja Davida Skoke kreće se prema jugu, na Korčulu. Ondje posjećuje Marka Turkovića, vrhunskoga chefa koji je radio u brojnim restoranima s dvije i tri Michelinove zvjezdice, a danas vodi svoj restoran u kojemu kuha isključivo na živoj vatri. Marko i David razgovarat će o tradicionalnim namirnicama, ali ih i pripremati po principima ulične hrane. U ovoj epizodi traže recepte za korčulansku uličnu hranu. R.: Radislav Jovanov Gonzo...

programme.title: Cocoa / Cacau
programme.desc: Cacao - (S01, E131, feature series, Portugal, 2024) telenovela talks about the life of a beautiful, brave and unbridled 22 -year -old girl Cacau who lives on a property where her parents are Portuguese, Joaquim and Filomena. They are hosts and people of the trust of the rich boss of Justin, a vase of Pereire, also a Portuguese, who is old and ill, and follows the business from Portugal. The best friends of Cacau are Pitty and Guto who help her make the idea that Brazil tasted the best chocolate - spicy chocolate from Itacare. Cacau works at the chocolate factory, and spends his free time in the warm sea of ​​Bahia where he loves surf. She is gifted with chocolate manufacturer, and her biggest dream is to get an international degree in confectionery and chocolate skills. However, she believes that this is unattainable because her family does not need money for that very expensive course. R.: Ricardo Carreira Ul.: Matilde Reymao (Cacau), Jose Condessa (Tiago), Alexandra Lencastre (Simone de Gusmao), Paulo Pires (Salomao), Ines Castel-Branco (Lala) ... / Cacao - (S01, E131, igrana serija, Portugal, 2024) Telenovela govori o životu lijepe, hrabre i neobuzdane 22-godišnje djevojke Cacau koja živi na imanju na kojemu su njezini roditelji Portugalci, Joaquim i Filomena. Oni su domaćini i ljudi od povjerenja bogatoga gazde Justina Vaza Pereire, također Portugalca, koji je star i bolestan, pa prati poslovanje iz Portugala. Najbolji prijatelji Cacau su Pitty i Guto koji joj pomažu ostvariti zamisao da Brazil kuša najbolju čokoladu - pikantnu čokoladu iz Itacarea. Cacau radi u tvornici čokolade, a slobodno vrijeme provodi u toplom moru Bahije gdje voli surfati. Nadarena je proizvođačica čokolade, a najveći joj je san dobiti međunarodnu diplomu iz slastičarstva i čokoladnih vještina. Ipak vjeruje da joj je to nedostižno jer njezina obitelj nema potreban novac za taj vrlo skup tečaj. programme.title: David Skoko: Eat on the road / David Skoko: Jesti na cesti
programme.desc: David Skoko: Eating on the road - (E04, Educational Program, Croatia, 2025) In the fourth episode, David Skoko visits a top chef who comes from Cakovec. Matija Bogdan has built a career at restaurants like Coi in San Francisco and London Ledbury, and today he is known for one of the most talented domestic chefs. His culinary direction is fine dining or high kitchen, so he will surely see street food in an original way. David and Matija are looking for recipes of local, Medimurje street food together. Matija Bogdan izgradio je karijeru u restoranima poput Coija u San Franciscu i londonskoga Ledburyja, a danas slovi za jednoga od najtalentiranijih domaćih chefova. Njegov kulinarski smjer je fine dining ili visoka kuhinja, pa će sigurno uličnu hranu vidjeti na originalan način. David i Matija zajedno traže recepte lokalne, međimurske ulične hrane. programme.desc: Oprah Winfrey: Fight for a Better Life - (Doc. Film, England, 2021) Oprah Winfrey is one of the most famous and influential women in the world. Media leader, leader of Talk shows, TV producer, actress, philanthropist ... Osnovala je vlastitu televizijsku mrežu "Oprah Winfrey Network" i producentsku kuću "Harpo Productions", koautorica je pet knjiga, nastupila je u nekoliko filmova te postala prva afroamerička milijarderka. Medijska liderica, voditeljica talk showova, TV producentica, glumica, filantropkinja... Mnogi je smatraju jednom od najutjecajnijih žena na svijetu, a njezin snažan utjecaj na društvo čak je poznat pod nazivom "Oprin efekt". Na svom je nevjerojatnom životnom putu nizala uspjeh za uspjehom. Bila je i ostala svoja, a zahvaljujući svojoj suosjećajnosti i pristupačnosti, dotakla je srca i nadahnula milijune ljudi diljem svijeta. Doznajte nešto više o njezinu putu od siromaštva do bogatstva i preprekama koje je na tome putu morala svladati te o tome kako se riješila bremena prošlosti i postala moćna i uspješna žena kakva je danas. programme.title: In battle! / U boj!
programme.desc: In battle! - (Educational program, Croatia, 2016) There are many bright moments in the centuries -old struggle of the Croatian people against different enemies. One of these is the heroic death of the Croatian prince Nikola Zrinski and the small troops of his fighters for the Turkish siege of the Hungarian city of Siget. When the last stronghold of the veterans was on fire after a month after a month, Zrinski, with the remaining soldiers on September 7, 1566. In the last color, almost everyone died, led by Nikola Zrinski. One of the greatest Turkish rulers, Sultan Suleiman II, did not welcome victory. He died two days before, and the great vizier Mehmed-pasha Sokolovic had to cover up his death so he would not discourage the Turkish army ahead of the attack. In Croatian history and the folk tradition of Nikola Zrinski, he remained remembered as one of the greatest heroes who sacrificed their lives for the survival of the homeland, and became the motive of numerous works of art. This documentary was made on the occasion of the 450th anniversary of the event at Siget. R .: Aldo Tardozzi ... / U boj! - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2016) U vjekovnoj borbi hrvatskog naroda protiv različitih neprijatelja ima mnogo svijetlih trenutaka. Jedan od takvih je i junačka pogibija hrvatskog kneza Nikole Zrinskog i male čete njegovih boraca za turske opsade ugarskog grada Sigeta. Kad se poslije mjesec dana opsade posljednje uporište branitelja našlo u plamenu, Zrinski je s preostalim vojnicima 7. rujna 1566. izveo junački juriš iz tvrđave. U zadnjem boju gotovo svi su izginuli na čelu s Nikolom Zrinskim. Jedan od najvećih turskih vladara, sultan Sulejman II., nije dočekao pobjedu. Umro je dva dana prije, a veliki vezir Mehmed-paša Sokolović morao je prikriti njegovu smrt kako ne bi obeshrabrio tursku vojsku uoči napada. U hrvatskoj povijesti i narodnoj tradiciji Nikola Zrinski ostao je upamćen kao jedan od najvećih junaka koji su žrtvovali svoj život za opstanak domovine, te postao motiv brojnih umjetničkih djela. Ovaj dokumentarni film snimljen je u povodu 450. obljetnice događaja kod Sigeta. R.: Aldo Tardozzi...

programme.title: Mountains / Planine
programme.desc: Mountains - (S02, E05, Educational Program, Croatia, 2024) We climb the unavoidable Vidova Gora, the highest peak of our islands 780 meters above sea level, then discover the secrets of the dragons of the cave and the Blaca desert - the miraculous residence of Glagolitic. According to the Brac hiking trails, we are led by a handball player, a national team player, the winner of the Olympic gold - Pero Metlicic. Originally from Split, where his parents live today, Pero always returned to Brac. Wherever he traveled, played and lived, Brac was his anchorage. With the "Mountain" team, Pero reveals the island that has neglected a bit during his successful career. His guides are Bracani who know Brac well - with Rank Dragicevic, a Brac mountaineer who passed Vi Adriatica and was on the Himalayas, climbs from Bol to Vidova up and from Blaca Bay to Blaca. With Zoran Kojdić from Murvica, he goes to the dragon's cave, and is led by the keeper of the monastery by Luka Vranjičić. R .: Maja Tokić ... / Planine - (S02, E05, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2024) Penjemo se na nezaobilaznu Vidovu goru, najviši vrh naših otoka 780 metara nadmorske visine, potom otkrivamo tajne Zmajeve pećine i pustinje Blaca - čudesnog prebivališta glagoljaša. Po bračkim planinarskim stazama vodi nas rukometaš, reprezentativac, osvajač olimpijskog zlata - Pero Metličić. Porijeklom iz Splitske, gdje danas žive njegovi roditelji, Pero se uvijek vraćao Braču. Gdjegod putovao, igrao i živio, Brač je bio njegovo sidrište. S ekipom "Planina" Pero otkriva otok koji je pomalo zapostavio tijekom svoje uspješne karijere. Njegovi su vodiči Bračani koji baš dobro poznaju Brač - s Rankom Dragičevićem, bračkim planinarom koji je prošao Viu Adriaticu i bio na Himalaji, penje se iz Bola do Vidove gore te iz uvale Blaca do pustinje Blaca. Sa Zoranom Kojdićem iz Murvica odlazi do Zmajeve pećine, a pustinjom Blaca vodi ga čuvar samostana Luka Vranjičić. R.: Maja Tokić...

programme.desc: Oprah Winfrey: Fight for a Better Life - (Doc. Film, England, 2021) Oprah Winfrey is one of the most famous and influential women in the world. She became famous for her revolutionary talk show that has been led for 25 years, which has gained huge popularity all over the world. She founded her own television network "Oprah Winfrey Network" and the Harpo Production Production House, the co -author of five books, performed in several films and became the first African -American billionaire. Media leader, leader of Talk shows, TV producer, actress, philanthropist ... Many consider her one of the most influential women in the world, and her strong influence on society is even known as "Oprarin effect." On her incredible life path, she was successful for success. She was and remained her own, and thanks to her compassion and accessibility, she touched her hearts and inspired millions of people around the world. Find out more about her path from poverty to wealth and obstacles she had to overcome along the way and how to get rid of the burden of the past and became a powerful and successful woman as she is today. This is the story of the Winfrey fight for a better life. R .: Roxane Schlumberger Ul.: Bonnie Greer, Simon Jenkins, Andrew Morton, Katie Nicholl, but destruction ... / Oprah Winfrey: Fight for a Better Life - (dok. film, Engleska, 2021) Oprah Winfrey jedna je od najpoznatijih i najutjecajnijih žena na svijetu. Proslavila se revolucionarnim talk showom koji je vodila punih 25 godina, a koji je stekao golemu popularnost u cijelome svijetu. Osnovala je vlastitu televizijsku mrežu "Oprah Winfrey Network" i producentsku kuću "Harpo Productions", koautorica je pet knjiga, nastupila je u nekoliko filmova te postala prva afroamerička milijarderka. Medijska liderica, voditeljica talk showova, TV producentica, glumica, filantropkinja... Mnogi je smatraju jednom od najutjecajnijih žena na svijetu, a njezin snažan utjecaj na društvo čak je poznat pod nazivom "Oprin efekt". Na svom je nevjerojatnom životnom putu nizala uspjeh za uspjehom. Bila je i ostala svoja, a zahvaljujući svojoj suosjećajnosti i pristupačnosti, dotakla je srca i nadahnula milijune ljudi diljem svijeta. Doznajte nešto više o njezinu putu od siromaštva do bogatstva i preprekama koje je na tome putu morala svladati te o tome kako se riješila bremena prošlosti i postala moćna i uspješna žena kakva je danas. Ovo je priča o borbi Opre Winfrey za bolji život. R.: Roxane Schlumberger Ul.: Bonnie Greer, Simon Jenkins, Andrew Morton, Katie Nicholl, Ali Razamanji...

programme.desc: Simon Reeves South America - (E04, Nature. Film, England, 2022) Simon Reeve travels through three most extreme landscapes on Earth: salty plains in Bolivia, Brazilian Panthanal and Chaco Forest in Paraguay. In Bolivia, Simon meets with a family who lives on the collection of salt on the vast expanse of salty plains Uyuni, who are so huge that they are allegedly visible from the moon. They will find out that there may be huge lithium deposits under the salt, a metal that is key to making batteries, especially those for a new generation of electric cars. Crossing in Brazil, Simon visits one of the biggest swamps - Pantanal and will experience a close encounter with Jaguar, the greatest predator in South America. Dries and fires threaten to panthanale, but there are a large threat and excessive flood. Simon will talk to a farmer who spent years building dams to stop water torrents and protect the family farm. During the last stage of this trip, Simon goes to the rarely visited Paraguay, in which he will find a unique community, which, despite being a small, has a great impact on the economy and ecology of this country. Menonites originally come from Europe, but they have moved around the world. Paraguay lives a particularly conservative branch that has renounced all the flow of modern times. They drive the cars with horses and speak their language known as the lower German. Simon will visit a school where children learn biblical texts in traditional costumes, and there is no smartphone in sight. However, menonites are very successful farmers and accept modern growing methods when needed and established spacious farms for cattle and soybeans. They intersected the vast expanses of the unique dry forest of Chaco, which extends in the area of ​​two Spanish and dominates the mid -South American continent. This economic miracle raised Paraguay to the very top of the world's food producers, but maybe that inevitably had its price. Simon concludes this stage of travel by a visit to the Ayoreo people. U Boliviji Simon se susreće s obitelji koja živi od skupljanja soli na golemom prostranstvu slanih ravnica Uyuni koje su tako goleme da su navodno vidljive i s Mjeseca. Saznat će da se ispod soli možda kriju goleme naslage litija, metala koji je ključan za izradu baterija, osobito onih za novu generaciju električnih automobila. Prešavši u Brazil, Simon posjećuje jednu od najvećih močvara - Pantanal te će doživjeti bliski susret s jaguarom, najvećim grabežljivcem u Južnoj Americi. Suše i požari prijete Pantanalu, ali velika su prijetnja i prekomjerne poplave. Simon će razgovarati s farmerom koji je proveo godine gradeći brane ne bi li zaustavio vodene bujice i zaštitio obiteljsku farmu. Tijekom zadnje etape ovog putovanja Simon odlazi u rijetko posjećivani Paragvaj u kojem će zateći jedinstvenu zajednicu koja, unatoč tome što je malobrojna, ima velik utjecaj na gospodarstvo i ekologiju ove zemlje. Menoniti izvorno potječu iz Europe, ali raselili su se diljem svijeta. U Paragvaju živi osobito konzervativni ogranak koji se odrekao svih tekovina modernog doba. Oni voze kola s konjima i govore svojim jezikom poznatim kako donjonjemački. Simon će posjetiti školu u kojoj djeca u tradicionalnim nošnjama uče biblijske tekstove, a na vidiku nema nijednog pametnog telefona. Međutim, Menoniti su vrlo uspješni farmeri i prihvaćaju moderne metode uzgoja kada je to potrebno te osnivaju prostrane farme za uzgoj stoke i soje. Oni su raskrčili golema prostranstva jedinstvene suhe šume Chaco koja se prostire na području veličine dvije Španjolske te dominira sredinom južnoameričkog kontinenta. Ovo je gospodarsko čudo podiglo Paragvaj na sam vrh svjetskih proizvođača hrane, ali možda je i to neizbježno imalo svoju cijenu. Simon ovu etapu putovanja zaključuje posjetom narodu Ayoreo. R.:...

A show, Croatia, 2023) In Dear Diklić, we are fortunate to watch and listen to a person who not only lived through a significant part of the contemporary history of our popular music, but in different ways embodies it. Doba je to šlagera, Opatije, plesnjaka, big bendova i jazza. Diklić u taj zavodljivi svijet zakoračuje kao saksofonist i pjevač, slijedeći put koji je kao neprikosnovena zvijezda utabao Ivo Robić. programme.title: A book or life / Knjiga ili život
programme.desc: Book or Life - (Artistic Program, Croatia) Our today's guest Dragan Velikic even received twice the NIN award for Best Novel, for the "Russian window" and "elderly". He is the recipient of the Milos Crnjanski Award, Mesa Selimovic, Kocic's Pero and numerous other awards. "Via Pula", the first novel by Dragan Velikać was published in 1988 in Serbian because, as the author says, he did not think about the content of Pula and the language of Belgrade; That was not excluded at the time. Velikic wanted to return Via Pula to her mother's speech, so in the Croatian edition of Roman Paola Orlic, she adapted the text and realized the writer's wish. The novel "Astrana" was published in 1991 in the famous hit Library Zlatko Crnkovic, but then remained confused with a whirlwind of war, so the new edition, three decades later, was the opportunity for the first and to others for a new reading during another, today's current war. Thus, the transformation books in time and the transformation itself have transformed ... / Knjiga ili život - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Naš današnji gost Dragan Velikić čak je dvaput dobio NIN-ovu nagradu za najbolji roman, za "Ruski prozor" i "Islednika". Dobitnik je nagrade Miloš Crnjanski, Meša Selimović, Kočićevo pero i brojnih drugih nagrada. "Via Pula", prvi roman Dragana Velikića objavljen je 1988. na srpskom jeziku jer, kako kaže autor, nije razmišljao o tome da je sadržaj pulski a jezik beogradski; to se tada nije isključivalo. Velikić je želio "Via Pulu" vratiti materinskom govoru pa je u hrvatskom izdanju romana Paola Orlić adaptirala tekst i ostvarila piščevu želju. Roman "Astragan" objavljen je 1991. u slavnoj Hit biblioteci Zlatka Crnkovića ali tada je ostao zameten vihorom rata pa je novo izdanje, tri desetljeća poslije, jednima prilika za prvo a drugima za novo čitanje u vremenu jednog drugog, danas aktualnog rata. Tako su se knjige koje se bave transformacijom u vremenu i same pomalo transformirale...

programme.title: Croatian submarine / Hrvatsko podmorje
programme.desc: The Croatian Podmorje - (S06, E01, known. Pop. Series, Croatia, 2003) The story of color emergence can be started every morning by sunrise. In addition to warmth, it is the strongest source of light, the light that we enter into the world of color. On the mainland, we learned to live with blue sky, green forests, gray cliffs, flowers of all possible colors, and our sea depths were always dark, inaccessible, threatening. Only when we started bringing artificial lighting to this dark -stainful world, did we begin to discover his amazing color. And we started learning about the sea properties of the sunlight and discover the amazing game and the struggle of two primordial elements - water and fire. In this fight, live creations were born, an unimaginable living world of submarine full of colors. And that color that is not on land, in combinations and patterns that are unthinkable in the air. Corals, gorgonia, snails, jellyfish, crustaceans, cephalopods, fish, algae doomed to forever blue have covered themselves with a variety of colors. And without artificial lighting, they do not see each other in the dark of depth at all, so the story of the colors of the living Adriatic and their purpose is even more surprising. R.: Miro Andrić ... / Hrvatsko podmorje - (S06, E01, znan. pop. serija, Hrvatska, 2003) Priču o nastanku boja možemo započeti svakog jutra izlaskom Sunca. Osim topline ono je najjači izvor svjetlosti, svjetlosti kojom ulazimo u svijet boja. Na kopnu smo naučili živjeti s plavim nebom, zelenim šumama, sivim liticama, cvijećem svih mogućih boja, a morske su nam dubine uvijek bile tamne, nepristupačne, prijeteće. Tek kada smo počeli donositi umjetnu rasvjetu u ovaj tamnomodri svijet, počeli smo otkrivati njegove začudne kolorite. A počeli smo i učiti o morskim svojstvima Sunčeve svjetlosti i otkrivati začudnu igru i borbu dva praiskonska elementa - vode i vatre. U toj borbi rođene su žive kreacije, nezamisliv živi svijet podmorja pun boja. I to boja kakvih nema na kopnu, u kombinacijama i šarama kakve su nezamislive na zraku. Koralji, gorgonije, puževi, meduze, rakovi, glavonošci, ribe, alge osuđene na vječno plavetnilo prekrile su se najrazličitijim bojama. A one se bez umjetne rasvjete uopće ne vide u tami dubina, pa nam je priča o bojama živog Jadrana i njihovoj svrsi još začudnija. R.: Miro Andrić...

But what happens when it comes to completely free improvisation? What if there is no jazz-narda to which soloists are being complemented, to be broken down by harmonious, melodic and rhythmically, which when there is no default or topic, or dynamics, no measures, notes, or rhythmic patterns, in fact any other instructions? programme.title: Klasika mundi / Klasika mundi
programme.desc: Classics Mundi - (Concert Film, Croatia, 2024) The concert of The Kings Singers at the Church of the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary in Osor officially opened the 49th Osor Music Evenings 2024. The Kings Singers was founded in 1968, when six former students of choral singing with Kings College held a concert in Queen Echento in Queen. Hall in London. By chance, it was made up of two counter -bodies, tenor, two baritone and bass, and this unique formation was still held. For more than fifty years, the ensemble has been setting up a gold standard in singing a cappella on the world's biggest stages. He is famed by unsurpassed technique, music and versatility, arising from a rich inheritance of the group and her aspirations to revive an extraordinary series of new and unique works, collaborations and recordings. programme.title: An angel at my table / Anđeo za mojim stolom
programme.desc: An Angel at My Table - (Drama, USA, 1990) The first movie from New Zealand shown at the Venice Film Festival. Awarded with a great special jury award, with a shouting of resentment because he did not win the golden lion. He has won numerous domestic and international awards and established Jane Campion as a director. Part 1: To the Is-Land Janet revealed a life-secret at the beginning of her childhood, including the power of language, the pleasure of telling stories and the mysteriousness of sex. Unfortunately, the beginning of her life was spoiled by her brother's fight against epilepsy and a shocking drowning of her distinctive older sister. It feels indescribably ordinary and unattractive, isolated at school and more and more in the world of poetry. Part 2: An angel at my table Janet is at university. She is a shy and serious student. Because he can no longer cope with increasing sensitivity, he tries to kill himself. She offers her rest and comfort she is looking for, but that has her price. He goes to a psychiatric institution where they diagnose that he has schizophrenia. She treats her electroses, and her other sister is drowning. All this will persecute her eight years full of despair. From the inevitable experimental leukotomy, she was only saved by writing. She comes out of the hospital and becomes an established writer with the help of a friend. She wrote her first amazing novel, and then thanks to the scholarship, she went on a trip to Europe. Part 3: The Envoy from Mirror City even though she is still shy, Janet enjoys the avant-garde life of the 1950s in London and Ibiza. In Spain, he is also experiencing his first romance, with an American poet, he struggles with an unplanned pregnancy, and later tries to survive and write in an inhospitable London. During his last stay at a psychiatric hospital, Janet is resolved by old diagnoses because they told her she never had schizophrenia. After her father died, he returned to New Zealand. Her country is happy about that, as well as her work and her imagination. R .: Jane Campion Ul.: Kerry Fox (Janet), Alexia Kegh (Young Janet ... / An Angel at My Table - (drama, SAD, 1990) Prvi film s Novog Zelanda prikazan na Filmskom festivalu u Veneciji. Nagrađen Velikom specijalnom nagradom žirija, uz povike negodovanja zato što nije osvojio Zlatnog lava. Osvojio je brojne domaće i međunarodne nagrade, te etablirao Jane Campion kao redateljicu. 1. dio: To the Is-Land Janet je na početku svojega djetinjstva otkrila životnu tajnu, uključujući snagu jezika, zadovoljstvo koje pruža pričanje priča i tajanstvenost seksa. Nažalost, početak života pokvarila joj je bratova borba protiv epilepsije te šokantno utapanje njezine osebujne starije sestre. Osjeća se neopisivo običnom i neprivlačnom, izolira se u školi te sve više tone u svijet poezije. 2. dio: An Angel at My Table Janet je na sveučilištu. Sramežljiva je i ozbiljna studentica. Budući da se više ne može nositi sa sve većom osjetljivošću, pokušava se ubiti. Ponude joj odmor i utjehu koje traži, ali to ima svoju cijenu. Odlazi u psihijatrijsku ustanovu gdje dijagnosticiraju da ima shizofreniju. Liječe je elektrošokovima, a utapa joj se i druga sestra. Sve će je to progoniti osam godina prepunih očaja. Od neizbježne eksperimentalne leukotomije spasilo ju je samo pisanje. Izlazi iz bolnice i postaje etablirana književnica uz pomoć prijatelja. Napisala je prvi nevjerojatni roman, a zatim je zahvaljujući stipendiji krenula na put Europom. 3. dio: The Envoy from Mirror City Iako je i dalje sramežljiva, Janet uživa u avangardnom životu 50-ih u Londonu i na Ibizi. U Španjolskoj proživljava i svoju prvu romansu, s američkim pjesnikom, bori se s neplaniranom trudnoćom, a poslije nastoji preživjeti i pisati u negostoljubivom Londonu. Tijekom posljednjeg boravka u psihijatrijskoj bolnici, Janet se rješava stigne stare dijagnoze jer su joj rekli da nikada nije imala shizofreniju. Nakon što joj je umro otac, vraća se na Novi Zeland. Njezina zemlja je sretna zbog toga, kao i njezin rad i njezina mašta. R.: Jane Campion Ul.: Kerry Fox (Janet), Alexia Keogh (Young Janet...

programme.title: My India / Moja Indija
programme.desc: My India - (E02, Nature. Film, Croatia, 2003) Haridwar and Rishikesh are located at the foot of the Himalayas where Ganges descends from the Himalayas and goes on a journey through India. Haridwar is also a pilgrimage place of the Hinduist, and every night pilgrims are prayed at the Brahmans at dusk. They release inflamed candles and flowers by ganges and thus celebrate the Divine River. Rishikesh is a center of yoga in India. A quiet small town located next to the clear ganges surrounded by the himalaya slopes is the right place for yoga and meditation. Apart from the famous Beatles who regularly visited the Rishikesh, many from all over the world come there seeking peace and harmony. R .: Ljubica Jankovic Lazaric ... / Moja Indija - (E02, prirod. film, Hrvatska, 2003) Haridwar i Rishikesh smjestili su se u podnožju Himalaja gdje se Ganges spušta s Himalaja i kreće na put po Indiji. Haridwar je i hodočasničko mjesto hinduista, a svake se večeri u sumrak hodočasnici mole predvođeni brahmanima. Puštaju upaljene svijeće i cvijeće po Gangesu i tako slave božansku rijeku. Rishikesh je centar joge u Indiji. Mirno malo mjesto smješteno uz bistri Ganges okruženo obroncima Himalaje pravo je mjesto za jogu i meditacije. Osim poznatih Beatlesa koji su Rishikesh redovito posjećivali, danas tamo dolaze mnogi sa svih strana svijeta tražeći mir i harmoniju. R.: Ljubica Janković Lazarić...

programme.title: Croatian submarine / Hrvatsko podmorje
programme.desc: Croatian submarine - (S06, E02, known. Pop. Series, Croatia, 2003), day by day, the world of submarine, as well as above sea, solves only one question. How to survive? How to feed yourself and not become food? Nature invented various techniques, but the most profanier were the ones that could be called a hide -like game. And again the light had a decisive role. In order to know the light, nature created a fantastic organ - an eye, and to fool it again, she created camouflage. The first hunters hunted prey thanks to the recognition of shapes, movements, colors. Therefore, perhaps the first strategy in the hide -friender game was a conceal color. The color you have to merge with the environment. And after her there was an explosion of camouflage ideas. The body shape is trying to break through various patterns, so masking the objects from the environment and finally the highlight - mimicry. A complete imitation of another kind, uninteresting and perhaps dangerous to your hunter. The submarine is many examples of top camouflage that land animals have not yet reached. R.: Miro Andrić ... / Hrvatsko podmorje - (S06, E02, znan. pop. serija, Hrvatska, 2003) Iz dana u dan živi svijet podmorja, kao i nadmorja, rješava samo jedno pitanje. Kako preživjeti? Kako se prehraniti, a ne postati hrana? Priroda je izumila razne tehnike, no najprofinjenije su bile one koje bi mogli nazvati igra skrivača. I opet je svjetlo imalo odlučujuću ulogu. Da bi se spoznalo svjetlo, priroda je stvorila fantastičan organ - oko, a da bi ga opet zavaralo, stvorila je kamufliranje. Prvi lovci lovili su plijen zahvaljujući prepoznavanju oblika, kretnji, boja. Stoga je možda prva strategija u igri skrivača bila prikrivna boja. Boja s kojom se morate stopiti s okolinom. A nakon nje došlo je do eksplozije ideja u kamufliranju. Oblik tijela pokušava se razbiti raznim šarama, pa maskiranjem predmetima iz okoliša i na kraju vrhunac - mimikrija. Potpuno oponašanje neke druge vrste, nezanimljive, a možda i opasne vašem lovcu. Podmorje je puno primjera vrhunske kamuflaže kakve kopnene životinje još nisu dostigle. R.: Miro Andrić...

programme.title: A collector of sounds / Skupljač zvukova
programme.desc: Sound collector - (E02, feature series, Croatia) Sound collector decides to camping in the garden tonight to discover night sounds! It is full of the moon and there is a lot of sounds: the night butterfly fluttering in the light of the tent, the owl from the distant tree ... These are all beautiful sounds. Then the fluttering of bats flying around in the moonlight is heard. Suddenly he hears a new sound - a rumble accompanied by sniffing. He starts recording while the noise is getting louder and closer. What could that be? Suddenly the ground shook, and in front of the tent, lit by moonlight, Mirta reads. Yes, she wanted to camping too! A night butterfly appears again in the tent, which scares Mirta, and she hides behind the collector of sounds. When he tries to show her that she should not be afraid of anything, she falls into the hole she dug outside the tent. They both agree that the night inside the fire is as good as camping. Whether inside or outside, it's best when they are together ... / Skupljač zvukova - (E02, igrana serija, Hrvatska) Skupljač zvukova večeras odlučuje kampirati u vrtu kako bi otkrio noćne zvukove! Pun je mjesec i puno je zvukova: lepršanje noćnoga leptira na svjetlu šatora, sova iz daleka stabla... sve su to prekrasni zvukovi. Tada se začuje lepršanje šišmiša koji lete uokolo na mjesečini. Iznenada čuje novi zvuk - tutnjavu koju prati njuškanje. Započne snimati dok buka biva sve glasnija i bliža. Što bi to moglo biti? Odjednom se tlo zatrese, a ispred šatora, obasjana mjesečinom, stoji Mirta. Da, i ona je htjela kampirati! U šatoru se ponovno pojavi noćni leptir koji uplaši Mirtu, a ona se sakrije iza Skupljača zvukova. Kad joj on pokuša pokazati da se ne treba ničega bojati, upadne u rupu koju je ona iskopala izvan šatora. Oboje se slože da je noć unutra uz vatru jednako dobra kao i kampiranje. Bilo unutra ili vani, najbolje je kad su zajedno...

programme.desc: Classics Mundi - (Concert Film, Croatia, 2024) The concert of The Kings Singers at the Church of the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary in Osor officially opened the 49th Osor Music Evenings 2024. The Kings Singers was founded in 1968, when six former students of choral singing with Kings College held a concert in Queen Echento in Queen. Hall in London. By chance, it was made up of two counter -bodies, tenor, two baritone and bass, and this unique formation was still held. For more than fifty years, the ensemble has been setting up a gold standard in singing a cappella on the world's biggest stages. He is famed by unsurpassed technique, music and versatility, arising from a rich inheritance of the group and her aspirations to revive an extraordinary series of new and unique works, collaborations and recordings. Extensive discography has brought the ensemble numerous awards, including two Grammy Awards, Emmy Award and a place in the Gramophone's famous magazines. For this festive occasion, they have prepared a program called Legacies, which celebrates the exceptional contributions to the music world over the past 500 years. On the one hand, the choral works of two of the most prominent English Renaissance composers, whose deaths have been four centuries last year, Thomas Weelkes and William Byrda, and on the other works of contemporary music by Gyorgy's League, whose provocative and avant -garde manuscript redefined the composition of the 20th century "Nonsense Madrigals". Between the Swedish romantic, Hugo Alfven, inspired by the folklore tradition of his country, and the premiere that emphasizes the important aspect of the action of The Kings Singers - "The dedication to the development of the global choir canon" - the new work of Croatian composer Blaženko Juračić Carmen de Doctrin (priority, with the 500th anniversary of the death of Marko Marulić). The program frames Close -Harmony Songs - a selection of multicolored songs performed in a tight syllable dominated by music from the "When you Wish Prosn a Star" released last year ... / Klasika mundi - (koncertni film, Hrvatska, 2024) Koncert ansambla The Kings Singers u crkvi Uznesenja Blažene Djevice Marije u Osoru svečano je otvorio 49. Osorske glazbene večeri 2024. Sastav The Kings Singers osnovan je 1968., kada je šest nekadašnjih studenata zborskog pjevanja s Kings Collegea u Cambridgeu održalo koncert u Queen Elizabeth Hallu u Londonu. Igrom slučaja, činila su ga dva kontratenora, tenor, dva baritona i bas, a ta se jedinstvena formacija održala i dalje. Ansambl već više od pedeset godina postavlja zlatni standard u pjevanju a cappella na najvećim svjetskim pozornicama. Glasovit je po nenadmašnoj tehnici, muziciranju i svestranosti, koje proizlaze iz bogatog naslijeđa grupe te njezine težnje da oživi izvanredan niz novih i jedinstvenih djela, suradnji i snimaka. Opsežna diskografija donijela je ansamblu brojna priznanja, uključujući dvije nagrade Grammy, nagradu Emmy i mjesto u Kući slavnih časopisa Gramophone. Za ovu svečanu prigodu pripremili su program nazvan Legacies, koji slavi iznimne doprinose svijetu glazbe u proteklih 500 godina. S jedne su strane zborska djela dvojice najistaknutijih engleskih renesansnih skladatelja od čije su smrti protekle godine prošla četiri stoljeća, Thomasa Weelkesa i Williama Byrda, a s druge djela velikana suvremene glazbe Gyorgyja Ligetija, čiji je provokativan i avangardan rukopis redefinirao kompoziciju 20. stoljeća i koji je upravo za sastav Kings Singers skladao "Nonsense Madrigals". Između su švedski romantičar Hugo Alfven, nadahnut folklornom tradicijom svoje zemlje, i praizvedba koja naglašava važan aspekt djelovanja ansambla The Kings Singers - "predanost razvijanju globalnog zborskog kanona" - novo djelo hrvatskog skladatelja Blaženka Juračića Carmen de doctrina (praizvedba, uz 500. godišnjicu smrti Marka Marulića). Sutra će Dianu i ostale tući, silovati i prodati. Ići će od jednih do drugih. Anne će ih prodati Hanninom klubu. Postat će žrtvama međunarodne mreže koja prodaje žene. Diana će jedne noći u klubu upoznati Rose. Zatražit će pomoć. Njihov je susret tračak nade u pakle koje te žene proživljavaju. programme.title: Maze / Labirint
programme.desc: Labyrinth - (Talk Show, Croatia, 2024) Šima and Draženka Čuljak, Mostar high school students, in January 1985. From their small Herzegovina village, they started on foot to Mostar. They inflamed in the satin blizzard and ended up in the chasm. In the canyon near Siroki Brijeg, to the minus twenty, they survived seven days and nights without food and water. Their survival at the border of possible united the whole former country. In the first episode of the maze, look at how they managed and the sister Culjak fought in those seven days ... / Labirint - (talk show, Hrvatska, 2024) Šima i Draženka Čuljak, mostarske srednjoškolke, u siječnju 1985. iz svog malog hercegovačkog sela krenule su pješice prema Mostaru. Upale su u sježnu mećavu i završile u provaliji. U kanjonu nadomak Širokog Brijega, na minus dvadeset, preživjele su sedam dana i noći bez hrane i vode. Njihovo preživljavanje na granici mogućeg ujedinilo je cijelu bivšu zemlju. U prvoj epizodi Labirinta pogledajte kako su se snalazile i s čim su se borile u tih sedam dana sestre Čuljak...

programme.title: Italian / Italiana
programme.desc: Italiana - (E01, Nature. Film, Italy) We discover the most important carnival in Europe: the carnival in the city of Viareggio in Tuscany. Entertainers, creatives, the builders of the "Papier-Mâche" car, irony, through fun and satire, show the good and evil of our time. In the former tobacco factory, you can feel a breath of the future. "Aria Green" is a great combination of companies and startups from all over the world dealing with industrial innovation. The city of Matera has been a World Heritage List on the UNESCO since 1993. Here the cave is both above and below the ground. The excellence of the Italian nylon is current again. This is a story of faith in a recycled nylon thread. Old threads of unfortunate fishing networks, discarded fabrics and waste remains are converted into new material, and thus a new life is breathed. The treasure from Langhea in Pimontu always had the smell of truffle. You have to look for him in the forests of Langhe during the forests. It grows along the roots of trees such as poplar, linden, oaks and willows, but only the dog's nose can enter it. The process of drying out by freezing today opens new opportunities ... / Italiana - (E01, prirod. film, Italija) Otkrivamo najvažniji karneval u Europi: karneval u gradu Viareggio u Toskani. Zabavljači, kreativci, graditelji kola od "papier-mâchea" ironijom, kroz zabavu i satiru, prikazuju dobro i zlo našeg vremena. U bivšoj tvornici duhana u Roveretu možete osjetiti dašak budućnosti. "Aria Green" je sjajan splet tvrtki i startupova iz cijelog svijeta koji se bave industrijskim inovacijama. Grad Matera na UNESCO-vu je popisu svjetske baštine od 1993. godine. Ovdje spilja ima i iznad i ispod zemlje. Izvrsnost talijanskog najlona ponovno je aktualna. Ovo je priča o vjeri u reciklirani najlonski konac. Stare niti nekorištenih ribarskih mreža, odbačenih tkanina i otpadnih ostataka pretvorene su u nov materijal, a time im se udiše i nov život. Blago iz Langhea u Pijemontu uvijek je imalo miris tartufa. Tražiti ga morate danju u šumama Langhea. Raste uz korijenje stabala kao što su topole, lipe, hrastovi i vrbe, ali u trag mu može ući samo pseći nos. Proces isušivanja zamrzavanjem danas otvara nove mogućnosti...

programme.title: In battle! / U boj!
programme.desc: In battle! - (Educational program, Croatia, 2016) There are many bright moments in the centuries -old struggle of the Croatian people against different enemies. One of these is the heroic death of the Croatian prince Nikola Zrinski and the small troops of his fighters for the Turkish siege of the Hungarian city of Siget. When the last stronghold of the veterans was on fire after a month after a month, Zrinski, with the remaining soldiers on September 7, 1566. In the last color, almost everyone died, led by Nikola Zrinski. One of the greatest Turkish rulers, Sultan Suleiman II, did not welcome victory. He died two days before, and the great vizier Mehmed-pasha Sokolovic had to cover up his death so he would not discourage the Turkish army ahead of the attack. In Croatian history and the folk tradition of Nikola Zrinski, he remained remembered as one of the greatest heroes who sacrificed their lives for the survival of the homeland, and became the motive of numerous works of art. This documentary was made on the occasion of the 450th anniversary of the event at Siget. R .: Aldo Tardozzi ... / U boj! - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2016) U vjekovnoj borbi hrvatskog naroda protiv različitih neprijatelja ima mnogo svijetlih trenutaka. Jedan od takvih je i junačka pogibija hrvatskog kneza Nikole Zrinskog i male čete njegovih boraca za turske opsade ugarskog grada Sigeta. Kad se poslije mjesec dana opsade posljednje uporište branitelja našlo u plamenu, Zrinski je s preostalim vojnicima 7. rujna 1566. izveo junački juriš iz tvrđave. U zadnjem boju gotovo svi su izginuli na čelu s Nikolom Zrinskim. Jedan od najvećih turskih vladara, sultan Sulejman II., nije dočekao pobjedu. Umro je dva dana prije, a veliki vezir Mehmed-paša Sokolović morao je prikriti njegovu smrt kako ne bi obeshrabrio tursku vojsku uoči napada. U hrvatskoj povijesti i narodnoj tradiciji Nikola Zrinski ostao je upamćen kao jedan od najvećih junaka koji su žrtvovali svoj život za opstanak domovine, te postao motiv brojnih umjetničkih djela. Ovaj dokumentarni film snimljen je u povodu 450. obljetnice događaja kod Sigeta. R.: Aldo Tardozzi...

programme.desc: The film monitors the life of a mound migrant, fortunate, called Jupiter Jones (Mila Konis), and she does not find a job other than toiletics. Jupiter Caen (Channing Tatum), a transit warrior for planets sent by the queen of the universe to kill Jupiter. Jupiter soon learned from Caen that the night of her birth witnessed a strange accident and that her DNA would make it a leader of the world. / يرصد الفيلم حياة مهاجرة روسية تعيسة الحظ تُدعى جوبيتر جونز (مايلا كونيس) ولا تجد أمامها عمل غير وظيفة مسح المراحيض. تقابل جوبيتر كاين (تشانينج تاتوم)، وهو محارب عابر للكواكب أُرسل من قبل ملكة الكون من أجل قتل جوبيتر. وسرعان ما تعلم جوبيتر من كاين أن ليلة مولدها شهدت حادثًا غريبًا وأن حمضها النووي سيجعلها قائدةً للعالم.

programme.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom / Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
programme.desc: Four years after the destruction of the Jurassic Garden; Because of the dinosaurs that have completely out of control, and after a dormant volcanoes on the island, Owen (Chris Prat) and Claire (Price Dallas Howard) go to a very difficult mission to save the remaining dinosaurs from death. / بعد مرور أربع سنوات على الدمار الذي جرى للحديقة الجوراسية؛ بسبب الديناصورات التي خرجت عن السيطرة تمامًا، وبعد فوران أحد البراكين الخامدة على سطح الجزيرة، يتوجه كل من أوين (كريس برات)، وكلير (برايس دالاس هوارد) في مهمة بالغة الصعوبة في سبيل إنقاذ الديناصورات الباقية من الموت.

programme.title: Kong: Skull Island / Kong: Skull Island
programme.desc: During the 1970s in the United States of America, a group of explorers and soldiers goes out on an arduous journey towards a remote island located in the heart of the Pacific Ocean; Investigations around and about what it contains, to the legendary (Kong), the king of this island and what is on it. / خلال حقبة السبعينات في الولايات المتحدة اﻷمريكية، يقوم مجموعة من المستكشفين والجنود بالخروج في رحلة شاقة نحو جزيرة نائية تقع في قلب المحيط الهادئ؛ وتبدأ التحريات حولها وحول ما تحتويه، وصولًا إلى (كونج) اﻷسطوري، ملك هذه الجزيرة وما عليها.

programme.title: Pacific Rim / Pacific Rim
programme.desc: When you come out of the depths of the ocean, giant monsters come from another world, they destroy entire cities and lead to the lives of millions, humans make a massive mechanism called "Gypsies" to fight those creatures, provided that each Jarger is controlled by pilots of human beings, but all this does not help in front of these tremendous creatures, and the war continues for more than 20 years, in which human civilization is almost collapsed, before that A new hope emerges on the horizon. / عندما تخرج من أعماق المحيط وحوش عملاقة آتية من عالم آخر، تقوم بتدمير مدن بأكملها وتودي بحياة الملايين، يقوم البشر بصناعة آليين هائلي الحجم يطلق عليهم "جياجرز" لمحاربة تلك الكائنات، على أن يتم التحكم في كل جياجر عن طريق طيارين من البشر، لكن كل هذا لا يجدي نفعاً أمام تلك المخلوقات الجبارة، وتستمر الحرب لأكثر من 20 عامًا، تكاد فيها حضارة البشر أن تنهار، قبل أن يبزغ أمل جديد في الأفق.

programme.title: Edge of Tomorrow / Edge of Tomorrow
programme.desc: In a science fiction atmosphere, the film monitors the story of a soldier named William Kidge (Tom Cruise). Kidge has not been battle before, but he finds himself besieged in a suicide bomber and in a few minutes being killed. In a way, he finds himself living the battle again as he fights, kills and returns again again, fighting and killing, and every time he acquires new combat skills. Therefore, he unites with a special forces called Rita (Emily Blant) to fight a fierce attack by the Memix coming from space. / في جو الخيال العلمي يرصد الفيلم قصة جندي يُدعى وليام كيدج (توم كروز). كيدج لم يخض معركةً من قبل ،لكنه يجد نفسه محاصرًا في عملية انتحارية وفي دقائق معدودة يُقتل. وبطريقةٍ ما يجد نفسه يعيش المعركة من جديد حيث يحارب ويُقتل ويعود من جديد مرةً أخرى يحارب ويُقتل، وفي كل مرة يكتسب مهارات قتالية جديدة. ولذلك يتحد مع امرأة من القوات الخاصة تُدعى ريتا (إيميلي بلانت) من أجل محاربة هجومٍ شرسٍ من قبل الميمكس القادمين من الفضاء.

programme.title: The Green Mile / The Green Mile
programme.desc: (Paul) is a guardian of the prisoners who are sentenced to death, and he is known for his sarcasm and extreme mockery, and his ability to control his nerves, and his skill in his work, arrives (Kofi); He is sentenced to death, on charges of killing two children, Paul discovers that Kofi, despite the magnitude of his body, and the ugliness of his crime, possesses the heart of a child, and supernatural abilities, which changes his life and the life of his colleagues completely. / (بول) حارس لزنازين المساجين المحكوم عليهم بالإعدام، وهو معروف بتهكمه وسخريته الشديدة، وقدرته على التحكم في أعصابه، ومهارته في عمله، يصل(كوفي)؛ وهو محكوم عليه بالإعدام، بتهمة قتل طفلين، يكتشف بول أن كوفي على الرغم من ضخامة جسده، وبشاعة جريمته، يمتلك قلب طفل، وقدرات سحرية خارقة، ذلك الأمر الذي يُغيّر حياته وحياة زملائه تمامًا.

programme.title: The Green Hornet / The Green Hornet
programme.desc: A playful young man named (Brett) inherits a great company from his father, his life full of parties, and amusement when he meets the Kung Fu expert (Kato), where he will be miscarriage of a robbery, and he becomes one of the superheroes who fight crime and terrorism. / شاب لعوب يُدعى (بريت) يرث شركة كبيرة عن والده، تتغير حياته المليئة بالحفلات، واللهو عندما يقابل خبير الكونج فو (كاتو)، حيث يتولى سويا إجهاض عملية سطو، ويصبح من الأبطال الخارقين الذين يحاربون الجريمة، والإرهاب.

programme.title: Men in Black II / Men in Black II
programme.desc: The two clients (J) and (K) meet to work together, to resolve the murder of a satellite murder on the planet, leading them to discover the satellite plot (Serlena) and its aides to steal a Hungarian necklace that threatens the fate of the planet and eliminates the entire humanity. / يجتمع العميلين (جيه) و(كيه) للعمل معًا، لحل قضية جريمة قتل أحد الفضائيين على كوكب الأرض، مما يؤدي بهم إلى إكتشاف مؤامرة الفضائية (سيرلينا) وأعوانها لسرقة قلادة مجرية تتسبب في تهديد مصير كوكب الأرض والقضاء على البشرية بأكملها.

programme.title: Couples Challenge Program / برنامج تحدي الأزواج
The hidden camera / الكاميرا الخفية
programme.desc: A group of dumps in which the guests fall, and the artist (Ibrahim Nasr) is presented, and among the most prominent characters that was embodied by the personality of a woman named (Zakia Zakaria). / مجموعة من المقالب التي يقع فيها الضيوف، ويقدمها الفنان (إبراهيم نصر)، ومن أبرز الشخصيات التي جسدها شخصية سيدة اسمها (زكية زكريا).

programme.title: Coercion / زواج بالإكراه
programme.desc: (Laila) A wealthy young man who is exposed to a traffic accident, which is bleeding and needs a quick blood transfusion, coincides with the blood type of her blood type with her private driver's blood, he transports blood to her without knowing that he himself is sick with AIDS and the disease moves to her, the young woman's life turns into misery and waiting for death, and she loves a new young man in her father's company named (Ahmed), but he does not exchange love; Because he loves (Hind), which he is about to marry, her father (Saeed Al -Koumi) threatens him to kill his fiancée and relatives in order to force him to marry his sick daughter with AIDS, and the events continue. / (ليلى) شابّة ثرية تتعرَّض لحادثة مرورية تنزف إثرها وتحتاج إلى نقل دم سريع، يتصادف أن تتطابق فصيلة دمها مع فصيلة دم سائقها الخاص، ينقل لها دمًا منه دون أن يعلم أنه هو نفسه مريض بالإيدز وينتقل إليها المرض، تنقلب حياة الشابة إلى تعاسة وانتظار للموت، وتحب شابًّا جديدًا في شركة أبيها اسمه (أحمد)، لكنه لا يبادلها الحب؛ لأنه يحب (هند) التي هو على وشك الزواج بها، يقوم والدها (سعيد الكومي) بتهديده بقتل خطيبته وأقاربه حتى يجبره على الزواج من ابنته المريضة بالإيدز، وتتوالى الأحداث.

programme.title: My heart and key / قلبي ومفتاحه
programme.desc: A divorced woman seeks to return to her husband for her young son by finding a man who plays the role of the (analyst), then she meets by chance a driver in one of the private transport applications while he is not married, and he is marrying him to resolve her crisis, without revealing to him her true motivation to marry him. / تسعى امرأة مطلقة للعودة إلى زوجها من أجل ابنها الصغير عن طريق إيجاد رجل يقوم بدور الـ(مُحلل)، ثم تلتقي عن طريق الصدفة بسائق في إحدى تطبيقات النقل الخاص وهو غير متزوج، وتعرض عليه الزواج لحل أزمتها، دون أن تكشف له عن دافعها الحقيقي للزواج منه.

programme.desc: (Sweet People) program is a specialized medical program. The program hosts doctors to find out medical information and to respond to consultations. / برنامج (الناس الحلوة) هو برنامج طبي متخصص، يستضيف البرنامج أطباء لمعرفة معلومات طبية وللرد على الاستشارات.

programme.title: 90 minutes / 90 دقيقة
programme.desc: One of the most important talk shows began to broadcast in 2006 with Moataz Al -Demerdash and Reham Al -Sahli, but in 2011 the journalist Amr Al -Laithi joined the program after Al -Demerdash withdrew from his presentation. The program is concerned with important news and daily events that revolve in the Egyptian and Arab street, as well as monitor the interests, opinions and aspirations of viewers, as well as many guests from politicians, media and economics. / أحد أهم البرامج الحوارية بدأ إذاعته عام 2006 مع معتز الدمرداش وريهام السهلي، ولكن في عام 2011 انضم الإعلامي عمرو الليثي للبرنامج بعد أن انسحب الدمرداش من تقديمه. يهتم البرنامج بالأخبار المهمة والأحداث اليومية التي تدور في الشارع المصري والعربى، كما يرصد أيضاً اهتمامات المشاهدين وآراءهم وتطلعاتهم، كما يستقبل العديد من الضيوف من رجال السياسة والإعلام والاقتصاد.

programme.title: Dalaa girls / دلع بنات
programme.desc: The series revolves around a comic framework about class differences in society through the story of two friends, one of which belongs to the popular class, while the other belongs to the bourgeois class, and this difference between them generates many paradoxes and comic situations. / تدور أحداث المسلسل في إطار كوميدي حول الفوارق الطبقية في المجتمع من خلال قصة صديقتين، تنتمي إحداهما للطبقة الشعبية، بينما تنتمى الأخرى للطبقة البرجوازية، ويولد هذا الاختلاف بينهما العديد من المفارقات والمواقف الكوميدية.

programme.title: peacock / الطاووس
programme.desc: Kamal the fleet is a veteran lawyer interested in compensation cases, but the conditions compel him to investigate one of the rape cases that turn his life upside down. / كمال الأسطول محامي مخضرم مهتم بقضايا التعويضات، ولكن الظروف تضطره كي يحقق في إحدى قضايا اﻻغتصاب التي تقلب حياته رأسا على عقب.

programme.title: Raya and Sakina / ريا وسكينة
programme.desc: The story of the life of the two sisters (Raya) and (Sakina), which are one of the most famous criminals of the twentieth century in Egypt. The women spared the beginning of the century and were behind the killing of dozens, and the series shows the circumstances that led to the transformation of the two sisters Raya and Sakina into two criminals, reviewing the developments of their lives and their access to those around them, and the impact of the environment in which the two sisters grew up on their future. / قصة حياة الأختين (ريا) و(سكينة)، وهما من أشهر مجرمات القرن العشرين في مصر. روعتا النساء في مطلع القرن وكانتا وراء مقتل العشرات، ويعرض المسلسل الظروف التي أدت إلى تحول الأختين ريا وسكينة إلى مجرمتين مستعرضًا تطورات حياتهما وصلتهما بالمحيطين بهما، وتأثير البيئة التي نشأت فيها الأختان على مستقبلهما.

programme.title: Covenant / العهد
programme.desc: The events take place inside the Damascene neighborhood in two time periods separated by 15 years, during the period before the liberation of Damascus from the Ottoman occupation, and its hegemony period on the neighborhood, where a strong conflict between the elders and notables of the neighborhood is born to respond and resist it. / تدور الأحداث داخل حارة دمشقية في مرحلتين زمنيتين تفصل بينهما 15 سنة، خلال الفترة التي سبقت تحرير دمشق من الاحتلال العثماني، وفترة هيمنته على الحارة، حيث يولد نزاع قوي بين وجهاء وأعيان الحارة للرد عليه ومقاومته.

programme.title: House of distress / بيت الشدة
programme.desc: A granddaughter and magician's granddaughter called (astronomer) returning to her grandfather's house, in order to take revenge on those who burned the house in the past, in light of a curse chasing her son Saif, which is the domination of the spirit of the grandfather on his body, and she finds herself in the face of the confrontation of the people of Al -Hara led by (Mukhtar) and soon things develop. / حفيدة مشعوذ وساحر تُدعى (فَلك) تعود إلى منزل جدها، لأجل الانتقام مِن مَن حرقوا المنزل قديمًا، في ظل وجود لعنة تطارد ابنها سيف وهي سيطرة روح الجد على جسده، فتجد نفسها في مواجهة تصدي أهل الحارة لها بقيادة (مختار) وسرعان ما تتطور الأمور.

The women spared the beginning of the century and were behind the killing of dozens, and the series shows the circumstances that led to the transformation of the two sisters Raya and Sakina into two criminals, reviewing the developments of their lives and their access to those around them, and the impact of the environment in which the two sisters grew up on their future. / قصة حياة الأختين (ريا) و(سكينة)، وهما من أشهر مجرمات القرن العشرين في مصر. روعتا النساء في مطلع القرن وكانتا وراء مقتل العشرات، ويعرض المسلسل الظروف التي أدت إلى تحول الأختين ريا وسكينة إلى مجرمتين مستعرضًا تطورات حياتهما وصلتهما بالمحيطين بهما، وتأثير البيئة التي نشأت فيها الأختان على مستقبلهما.

The secret of the earth / سر الأرض
programme.desc: The events of the series (which continued to be filmed and displayed for several years) revolve around a group of comic situations, reviewing the importance and preservation of the land, and aims to spread awareness, advice, information about agriculture and its concern, in addition to other agricultural projects (such as animal raising), and to provide this information to the peasant category, with the aim of helping them to complete their important and necessary profession for society. / تدور أحداث المسلسل (والذي استمر تصويره وعرضه لعدة سنوات) حول مجموعة من المواقف الكوميدية، تستعرض أهمية الأرض والحفاظ عليها، ويهدف إلى نشر التوعية والنصائح والمعلومات الخاصة بالزراعة وما يخصها، بالإضافة إلى المشروعات الزراعية الأخرى (مثل تربية الحيوانات)، وتقديم هذه المعلومات لفئة الفلاحين، بهدف إعانتهم على استكمال مهنتهم الهامة، والضرورية للمجتمع.

programme.desc: In each episode of the series, the media (Samia Al -Ibary) collects the children around them every day in order to recount the adventures of (Al -Sinbad Maritime) in the high seas, and what he meets in all his trips of the horrors and risks that take it to new areas and new lands that were not responded to humans. / في كل حلقة من حلقات المسلسل، تقوم اﻹعلامية (سامية الإتربي) بجمع الأطفال من حولها في كل يوم لكي تسرد عليهم مغامرات (السندباد البحري) في أعالي البحار، وما يقابله في كافة رحلاته من أهوال ومخاطر تأخذه إلى مناطق جديدة وأراضٍ جديدة لم تَرِدْ على بال بشر.

programme.title: Nose and three eyes / أنف وثلاث عيون
programme.desc: Egyptian drama deals with the story of a woman who admires a successful man in his work, even though she is married and establishes a relationship with him and after a while he tries to persuade her to return to her husband, but she refuses, one of his sick patients meets psychologically and suffers from her inability to move, he decides to marry her, but she surprises him that she has a relationship with a man who spends on her. / دراما مصرية تتناول قصة سيدة تُعجب برجل ناجح في عمله رغم أنها متزوجة وتقيم معه علاقة وبعد فترة يحاول ان يقنعها بالعودة لزوجها ولكنها ترفض، يلتقي إحدى مريضاته المريضة نفسيا وتعاني من عدم قدرتها على الحركة، يقرر الزواج منها ولكنها تفاجئه أن لها علاقة برجل يقوم بالإنفاق عليها.

programme.title: Modern and supplication program / برنامج حديث ودعاء
The return of Amo Fouad (Amo Fouad, see, O Walad) / عودة عمو فؤاد (عمو فؤاد راجع يا ولاد)
programme.desc: This series of Fawazir (Amo Fouad) is based on providing information about a specific city or governorate, and children must know this province or the city that is covered by the uniform of the episode. / تقوم هذه السلسلة من فوازير (عمو فؤاد) على تقديم معلومات عن مدينة أو محافظة معينة، وعلى الأطفال معرفة هذه المحافظة أو المدينة التي تتناولها فزورة الحلقة.

programme.title: One Thousand and One Nights: The grace and roses of God / ألف ليلة وليلة: فضل الله ووردانه
programme.desc: This part of the fictional series (One Thousand and One Nights) deals with a story titled (Fadlallah and Ruwana), their separation from each other, and the adventures they are exposed to until their meeting again. / يتناول هذا الجزء من المسلسل الخيالي (ألف ليلة وليلة) قصة حملت عنوان (فضل الله ووردانة)، وفراقهما عن بعضهما، والمغامرات التي يتعرضون لها حتى اجتماعهم مرة أخرى.

programme.title: The modern soul program / برنامج حديث الروح
Justice has many faces / للعدالة وجوه كثيرة
programme.desc: (Jaber Mamoun Nassar) A famous businessman who has his reputation and his good reputation among people and lives with his wife and daughter a quiet life, tried to hide his truth throughout his life as an illegitimate child, but a murder occurred and is being investigated in it, revealing all the hidden past. / (جابر مأمون نصار) رجل أعمال مشهور و له صيته وسمعته الطيبة بين الناس ويعيش مع زوجته وابنته حياة هادئة، حاول إخفاء حقيقته طوال حياته كونه طفل غير شرعي، إلا أن جريمة قتل تحدث ويتم التحقيق معه فيها، تكشف كل الماضي المستور.

programme.title: God's Most Beautiful Names Program / برنامج أسماء الله الحسنى
Diary and Nice C1 / يوميات ونيس ج1
programme.desc: Winis (Mohamed Sobhi) and his wife, Maysa (Souad Nasr), raising their four children on the good morals and values, and while performing this message, they discover that they disagree with many of the values ​​that they are trying to plant in their children, so they try to correct themselves. / يقوم ونيس (محمد صبحي) وزوجته مايسة (سعاد نصر) على تربية أبناءهما الأربعة على الأخلاق والقيم الصالحة، وأثناء تأديتهم لهذه الرسالة يكتشفان أنهما يخالفان الكثير من القيم التي يحاولنان زرعها في أولادهما، فيحاولان التصحيح من نفسيهما.

programme.title: Modern and supplication program / برنامج حديث ودعاء
Omar bin Abdulaziz / عمر بن عبدالعزيز
programme.desc: The series deals with the biography of the fifth adult caliphs (Omar bin Abdul Aziz), starting from its upbringing as an Umayyad young man, and until its arrival in the chair of government, how he led the country and ruled it with righteousness and justice in the shadow of an era that was full of temptations and wars, and how it contributed to the spread of Islamic conquests in the world. / يتناول المسلسل السيرة الذاتية لخامس الخلفاء الراشدين (عمر بن عبد العزيز)، بداية من نشأته كشاب أموي، وحتى وصوله إلى كرسي الحكم، كيف قاد البلاد وحكمها بالصلاح والعدل في ظل عصر كان مليء بالفتن والحروب، وكيف ساهم في إنتشار الفتوحات اﻹسلامية في العالم.

programme.title: Asmahan / أسمهان
programme.desc: The work deals with the life story of the late singer Asmahan, from her birth until her transfer from Beirut to Cairo to work as a singer and actress, to shine her name next to her brother Farid Al -Atrash, and the series touches on her relationship with some of the artists who lived with her until her mysterious death. / يتناول العمل قصة حياة المطربة الراحلة أسمهان، منذ ميلادها حتى إنتقالها من بيروت إلى القاهرة للعمل كمطربة وممثلة، ليلمع اسمها بجوار شقيقها فريد الأطرش، ويتطرق المسلسل إلى علاقتها ببعض الفنانين الذين عاصروها وحتى حادث وفاتها الغامض.

programme.desc: Wondering where the villages of Ublo lie? At the time the legends were formed, it was light. This was what four brothers went to hunt and stopped on the spot they began to call Bratřejov. Then they went on and one stayed at the spring, decreased, so the place began to call Ublo. They reached the next place too late. And so he was late. A little farther away, they had been so disgusted that they said: Quite hunting! And so the Prlov originated. We are located northeast of Vizovice. Ubl's inhabitants have quite a lot of problems. Stranger people do not want to believe that something like this may exist. All of them are aware of how the name originated. Ublo said it meant a well. And according to what the locals say, there are really enough sources in the surrounding forests. / Zajímá vás, kde leží vesnice Ublo? V době, kdy vznikaly legendy, to bylo lehke. To se takhle jednou vydali na lov čtyři bratři a zastavili se na místě, kteremu začali říkat Bratřejov. Pak šli dál a u pramene jeden zůstal, ubyl, tak tomu místu začali říkat Ublo. Na další místo došli už dost pozdě. A tak z něj byl Pozděchov. O kus dál už se jim lov tak znechutil, že si řekli: Dosti lovu! A tak vznikl Prlov. Nacházíme se severovýchodně od Vizovic. Obyvatele Ubla mají s názvem dost problemů. Cizím lidem se nechce věřit, že něco takoveho může existovat. Všichni mají přitom jakesi povědomí, jak název vznikl. Ublo prý znamenalo studánku.
